images.note: Panel from the multi-source 286-294 GHz gallery (8''-wide square field of view centred on the emission peak). Compact, only marginally resolved peak at the ~1.0-1.2'' SMA beam scale. F(294 GHz) = 57.1 +/- 3.6 mJy, F(278 GHz) = 43.5 +/- 4.1 mJy (visibility-domain fits, Table 4). Table 1: R_95% = 0.13'' (~18 au at 140 pc), K5.5, single, group 3. This is a second, independent observation: the existing ylw-47 record in the atlas is the ALMA ODISEA Band 6 1.3 mm continuum image (Cieza et al. 2019, image_id ylw-47_odisea_b6cont, epoch 2017-07), so this SMA record is added alongside it and does not duplicate it. The 286-298 GHz high LSB data come from the SMA 270 GHz tracks 270 GHz-2a (2022-05-23, EXT) and 270 GHz-1 (2023-08-29, COM); the paper does not state which track contributes to which target.

notes: ODISEA C4 object 100: resolved 1.3 mm disk (deconvolved size in Cieza 2019 Table 3), F1.3mm=25.4 mJy; in Fig. 3 resolved-singles gallery but absent from atlas (coord+name cross-match)
